plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Engineering map for 2026-2027' and the pathway is for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every fixed course, category, unit value and term total; Table View shows no prerequisites column, so the 'Prerequisites' flags below are Card View only. The inventoried program 'Engineering' is listed in the mapper under that name; the program page states the student will be awarded an Associate of Science degree and prints no separate total-units statement. This plan transcribes the first-listed 2026-2027 pathway, 'Bakersfield College / Engineering / Associate of Science / 63-67.5 units / 4 terms / to CSU', in full; the page shows only the 4-term Bakersfield College segment. The second 2026-2027 pathway ('to Degree', 62-68.5 units, 4 terms) uses the Bakersfield College general-education pattern and is not collected as a separate plan. In 2025-2026 detailed maps existed in 5 terms for both pathways. The transcribed map prints term totals as 17-18.5 / 14-15 / 17 / 15-17. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Major List A' (3-4); Term 4 'Major List B' (3-5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 63 units. CHEM B1A and MATH C2211 are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; they are named major courses and are recorded with category 'major'. The 'Major List A' slot prints a closed two-course option set (ENGR B20 MATLAB Programming for Engineers & Scientists; ENGR B19C C++ Programming for Engineers & Scientists) and 'Major List B' prints a closed fifteen-course option set (PHYS B4C Optics and Modern Physics, MATH B6E Elementary Linear Algebra, ENGR B45 Properties of Materials, ENGR B40 Surveying, ENGR B38 Strength of Materials, ENGR B37 Engineering Mechanics-Dynamics, ENGR B36 Engineering Mechanics-Statics, ENGR B25 Engineering Graphics with AutoCAD (for CE/CET/EE), ENGR B24 Engineering Graphics with Solidworks, ENGR B18 Digital Electronics and Logic Design, COMP B14 Discrete Structures, COMP B13 Computer Architecture and Organization, COMP B11 Programming Concepts and Methodology I, CHEM B1B General Chemistry and Chemical Analysis, ENGR B17 Electric Circuit Analysis); per the standing slot convention the options are named here and the slots themselves are recorded unselected. CHEM B1A, MATH C2211, MATH C2221, PHYS B4A, MATH B6C, PHYS B4B and MATH B6D carry a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; no other row shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag, so no other prereqs are recorded. General-education slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. No separate Certificate program named Engineering exists in the mapper. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
